description: Issue #7. Lab rule: every image, package and download pinned to its latest version, exactly (setup/VERSIONS.md). One change per PR (nothing grouped, except two pins that must move together). Held-back items wait for approval on the Dependency Dashboard issue instead of opening a PR.
prBodyNotes: Lab rule: merge one at a time and run its check (setup/VERSIONS.md, "Check after a bump"); record it in the same commit.

packageRules.description: Images we build ourselves (not on a registry): nothing to look up.
llama-swap (and the llama.cpp inside): changes every speed and quality baseline. Approve on the dashboard, then measure before/after (issue #1). Tags: unified-vulkan-N.
prBodyNotes: Held back (issue #1): before/after `tuning/speed` + tool use x3 on the machine's model; re-test the grammar bug (CLAUDE.md Known issues).

packageRules.description: SearXNG: tags YYYY.MM.DD-commit; it publishes almost daily, so only Monday mornings (one PR a week at most).
prBodyNotes: Check: a search through the `search` tool (MCPJungle).

packageRules.description: Python minor or major (e.g. 3.12 -> 3.15) can break the packages built on it (Mnemosyne chose 3.12): approve on the dashboard. Same-minor updates and new digests are normal PRs.
prBodyNotes: Python minor/major: rebuild the images on it (hub/memory/*.Dockerfile, hub/comfyui) and run their checks; relays and stats only need `docker compose up -d`.
Check: browser tool loads a public page; `http://192.168.1.1/` gets 403; `squid-gnutls -k parse` OK.

packageRules.description: MCPJungle: the compose image and the CLI version in hub/mcp/setup.sh must stay the same version, so these two move together.
prBodyNotes: Check: `hub/mcp/setup.sh` (every server and client line), then `lab mcp status` ("Matches the repo").
Check: `lab webui drift` and `hub/openwebui/models.sh`: 0 differ. Read the changelog first for a new major.
Check: `hub/notify "test" "x"` arrives on the phone and desktop; the 10 access checks (plans/notifications-timeline.md).
Check: `recall` finds the REBUILD rule (plans/agent-infra.md 4b); rebuild hub/memory/mnemosyne.Dockerfile.

packageRules.description: Need a manual step Renovate can't do (a checksum, a measured kernel module, Enso's pi range): approve on the dashboard.
prBodyNotes: Manual part: bun needs the new sha256 in agents/enso/Dockerfile; Enso: check its supported pi range and run `lab enso check`; ec module: marvin/fan/ec-module.sh install and `check` (reboot not needed, measure fans).

Check: rebuild hub/memory/mcp-localrecall.Dockerfile, update its image tag in hub/compose.yaml (…-proxyX.Y.Z), then a `memory` search through MCPJungle and `lab enso check` (36 tools). 0.13.3 added a Host-header check (`--allowed-host`).

customManagers.description: MCPJungle CLI version in cli/lab.yaml (mcpjungle.version), for `lab mcp setup`; grouped with the image.
pip pins inside Dockerfiles (pip install name==X or "name[extras]==X").
bun download in agents/enso/Dockerfile (needs a new sha256 by hand: approval rule).
Fan-chip module source commit in marvin/fan/ec-module.sh.
